question: Does blossom.ditto.pub still enforce a 2 GB maximum upload and a 1 GB maximum media size, and what are its current storage-used and upload-rate figures?
why: The first-party page no longer publishes these figures; the BUD-06 HEAD preflight returns 401 (Nostr auth token required) and /upload, /api/info, /api/stats all answered 404, so the values cannot be re-established without an authenticated upload.
